findings.title: Empty-string effort treated as changed
findings.problem: effort is normalized with ?? null, so '' is not equal to null. Form schema is nullable and submit uses toEffortOrNull, so the select may emit '' when cleared.
findings.impact: Trigger: user clears the effort select on a model with no saved effort; false unsaved dialog. Whether the select emits '' was not confirmed; workaround is to discard.
findings.recommendation: Normalize with `|| null` for effort on both sides.

findings.title: Empty tool_permissions object differs from null
findings.problem: tool_permissions is normalized with ?? null, so {} is not equal to null/undefined.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: one side holds {} and the other null; the form flattens tool_permissions, so this is unlikely today. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Treat an empty object as null via lodash isEmpty on both sides.
